system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
systemPrompt: input.systemContext?.instructions
? { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: input.systemContext.instructions }
system_prompt_style.note: Claude Code preset plus per-agent CLAUDE.md/memory injection.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: TOOL_ALLOWLIST (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task, Skill, …)

context_compaction.evidence_quote: **PreCompact** hook archives the transcript to `conversations/` before compaction
context_compaction.note: SDK-native compaction; `system`/`compact_boundary` → 'Context compacted…'. tool_output_pruning inferred from SDK.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Initial prompt, already formatted by the agent-runner into a string.
observation_format.note: media handling exists in runner core, but LLM-facing observations documented as text.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: TOOL_ALLOWLIST (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task, Skill, …)

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: container/agent-runner/` — Bun agent-runner: poll loop, MCP tools, provider abstraction

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent-runner inside the container polls `inbound.db`, runs the agent, and writes responses to `outbound.db`.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: SDK_DISALLOWED_TOOLS blocks SDK builtins that collide with NanoClaw's own scheduling/interaction model (CronCreate/Delete/List, ScheduleWakeup, AskUserQuestion, Enter/ExitPlanMode, Enter/ExitWorktree)

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A single Node host orchestrates per-session agent containers.
multi_agent_topology.note: Task/subagent tool allowed within Claude SDK.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: May be emitted multiple times per query (e.g., Claude's multi-turn with subagents)

human_in_loop.note: AskUserQuestion disallowed; users interact via chat but no action gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the agent-runner stores one opaque `continuation` token per provider
short_term_state.note: session state, container_state, mailbox records beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: each agent group has its own `CLAUDE.md`, its own memory, its own container, and only the mounts you allow

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Resume via the SDK `resume` option keyed on the stored `continuation` (the SDK session ID)

self_verification.evidence_quote: the agent-runner decides **what** to send and **what to do** with results
self_verification.note: No harness-run tests, linters or judge documented.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `retryable` indicates whether the agent-runner should retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: **PreCompact** hook archives the transcript to `conversations/` before compaction
rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism documented in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: 60s sweep: stale detection, due-message wake, recurrence
termination_condition.note: turn ends on provider `result`; host idle ceiling kills stuck containers.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Provider is configurable per agent group.
cost_controls.note: Per-group model/effort selection; caching inferred from SDK, weak evidence.

timeouts.evidence_quote: records the current tool + its declared timeout to `container_state` (so the host sweep widens its stuck tolerance while a long Bash runs)

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Agents run in Linux containers and they can only see what's explicitly mounted.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: They can only access explicitly mounted directories.
filesystem_access.note: Scoped to mounts within the container boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: outbound API requests route through [OneCLI's Agent Vault](https://github.com/onecli/onecli), which injects authentication at the proxy level and supports rate limits and access policies
network_policy.note: Proxy-mediated egress with policies; no explicit full network disable documented.

tracing.evidence_quote: Ask Claude Code. "Why isn't the scheduler running?" "What's in the recent logs?"
tracing.note: Claude SDK writes .jsonl transcripts; upload-trace.ts exists but unexamined.

replayability.evidence_quote: Claude persists its own `.jsonl` transcript on disk keyed by the continuation (session ID)

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Trunk ships the registry and infrastructure, not specific channel adapters or alternative agent providers.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner in the file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: blocks any `SDK_DISALLOWED_TOOLS` call that slips through
guardrails.note: output_filters from credential injection at proxy (agents never hold raw API keys).

target_domain.evidence_quote: Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps,, has memory, scheduled jobs
target_domain.note: Personal assistant; web access via WebSearch/WebFetch; can modify its own codebase.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: `/add-opencode` for OpenRouter, Google, DeepSeek and more via OpenCode, and `/add-ollama-provider` for local open-weight models
model_agnostic.note: Default is Claude only; others via skills.
